<div class="card-body">
'''Out Of Nowhere''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">虚空からの奇襲</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">回避値＞3の君の宇宙船がいる星系カード上で相手が戦闘を始めた場合、1フォース消費して、戦闘運命数をもう1枚引く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-102o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">闇ルートで入手したステルス装置で、敵のセンサー探知機を無力化、さらに恒星が発する干渉波を隠れみのに使えば、奇襲攻撃は成功だ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Surprise from empty space.

'''Card text:''' If the opponent initiates a battle at a system where you have a starship with maneuver > 3, use 1 Force to add one battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' Black-market stealth gear blanks enemy sensors. Stellar interference then hides the ship for a surprise attack.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names a system; the English names a system or sector.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Out Of Nowhere]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
